Once removed, place the device into the charging dock which connects to the power source via the USB charging cord.   As far as the AC adapter, this accessory was removed from the multi-packs once our initial campaign ended on 4/15, due to the number of international orders. You can purchase the adapter on iTENS.com, or use any standard USB to AC adapter.
